Malik aims to convey grace and spirituality in his vocals, keeping it straightforward. title: Kiara spends quality time with her mother Genevieve before welcoming second child with Sidharth

She noted the importance of her friends' support during this difficult phase of her life. Kiara and Sidharth Malhotra announced their second pregnancy on October 7, which was welcomed with joy.

title: Ashok Saraf recalls how he paid Nana Patekar Rs 2 for back massage: 'Even though I told...'

A sleek black six-seater dining table pairs perfectly with a stylish bar corner. Equipped with state-of-the-art gym equipment, the fitness space complements the bedroom's serene neutral palette. title: Vijay shares Japan vacation pics with Rashmika, family: 'Celebrating Life with my fav people'
